# ToolPixi

> ToolPixi is a free collection of online tools — image compressors, PDF tools, calculators and converters — that run entirely in your browser. Your files never leave your device.

ToolPixi at https://toolpixi.com/ offers 70 free browser-based tools across 5 categories: image compression and conversion, PDF merge/split/compress, date and age calculators, countdowns, and everyday converters. No sign-up, no upload — processing happens on your device.

## Key pages

- [ToolPixi homepage](https://toolpixi.com/): Free online tools that run in your browser — compress, convert, and calculate in seconds.
- [About ToolPixi](https://toolpixi.com/about/): What ToolPixi is, why browser-based matters for privacy, and how the tools work.
- [Privacy Policy](https://toolpixi.com/privacy/): Files are never uploaded; no accounts; no tracking cookies from ToolPixi.
- [Contact](https://toolpixi.com/contact/): Suggest a tool, report a problem, or ask a question.
- [Sitemap](https://toolpixi.com/sitemap.xml): Complete list of tool pages.

## Categories

- Image Tools: 16 tools — including Image Compressor to KB, PNG to JPG, JPG to PNG, WebP to JPG, WebP to PNG. Compress photos to an exact KB size, convert formats and fix iPhone HEIC photos.
- PDF Tools: 9 tools — including JPG to PDF, Merge PDF, Split PDF, PDF to JPG, Compress PDF. Build, merge, split and shrink PDFs — right in your browser.
- Date & Time Tools: 23 tools — including Age Calculator, Age on a Specific Date, Days Between Dates, Days Until Christmas, Days Until New Year. Ages, countdowns and date differences, calculated instantly.
- Text & Generator Tools: 10 tools — including Word Counter, QR Code Generator, YouTube Thumbnail Downloader, Random Number Generator, Case Converter. Word counts, QR codes, thumbnails and random numbers.
- Converters & Calculators: 12 tools — including Unit Converter, BMI Calculator, Percentage Calculator, Tip Calculator, Discount Calculator. Units, BMI, percentages and everyday money maths.

## All tools

- [Image Compressor to KB](https://toolpixi.com/image-compressor/): Shrink a photo to exactly 50KB, 100KB, 200KB or any size you type.
- [PNG to JPG](https://toolpixi.com/png-to-jpg/): Convert PNG images to JPG — smaller files that upload anywhere.
- [JPG to PNG](https://toolpixi.com/jpg-to-png/): Convert JPG photos to PNG with full quality.
- [WebP to JPG](https://toolpixi.com/webp-to-jpg/): Turn WebP images into JPG files every app can open.
- [WebP to PNG](https://toolpixi.com/webp-to-png/): Convert WebP to PNG without losing transparency.
- [JPG to WebP](https://toolpixi.com/jpg-to-webp/): Make web-ready WebP images from JPG photos.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://toolpixi.com/heic-to-jpg/): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG on any device.
- [JPG to PDF](https://toolpixi.com/jpg-to-pdf/): Turn one or many photos into a single PDF document.
- [Merge PDF](https://toolpixi.com/merge-pdf/): Combine several PDFs into one file, in your order.
- [Split PDF](https://toolpixi.com/split-pdf/): Pull out page ranges or save every page as its own PDF.
- [PDF to JPG](https://toolpixi.com/pdf-to-jpg/): Convert each PDF page into a crisp JPG image.
- [Compress PDF](https://toolpixi.com/compress-pdf/): Shrink a PDF toward 200KB or 100KB for upload forms.
- [Age Calculator](https://toolpixi.com/age-calculator/): Your exact age in years, months and days from your date of birth.

## Privacy promise

Every tool processes files locally in your web browser using open-source libraries (pdf-lib, PDF.js, heic2any). Files and typed data are never transmitted to or stored on a server. Close the tab and nothing remains.
